name: praetorial-web-v0
description: Praetorial Option-1 wallet round trip: real Privy client SDK (browser) + server verify/broadcast on NEAR testnet, plus NEP-413 intents signing and passkey-recovery probe.

scripts.build:testnet: NETWORK_ID=testnet VITE_NETWORK_ID=testnet VITE_EXPLORE_HIDDEN=1-48 VITE_INDEXER_URL=/_proxy/indexer VITE_RELAYER_URL=/_proxy/relayer VITE_REGISTRY_URL=/_proxy/registry npm run build
scripts.deploy:testnet: node ../../services/workers/scripts/check-config-drift.mjs && npm run build:testnet && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.testnet.toml
scripts.build:kit: NETWORK_ID=testnet VITE_NETWORK_ID=testnet VITE_KIT=1 KIT_ONLY=1 vite build --outDir dist-kit --emptyOutDir
scripts.build:mainnet: NETWORK_ID=mainnet VITE_NETWORK_ID=mainnet VITE_INDEXER_URL=/_proxy/indexer VITE_RELAYER_URL=/_proxy/relayer VITE_REGISTRY_URL=/_proxy/registry VITE_SOURCECHECK_URL=https://sourcecheck.praetorial.com/sourcecheck npm run build
scripts.deploy:mainnet: npm run build:mainnet && tsx scripts/mainnetDeployGuard.ts && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.mainnet.toml
